sentences.en: Compared with last year, this year's crops are much better.
sentences.zh: 与去年相比，今年的收成要好得多。

sentences.en: The rain had a good effect on the farm crops.
sentences.zh: 雨水对农场的农作物有很好的影响。

sentences.en: Does the amount of rain affect the growth of crops?
sentences.zh: 降雨量会影响作物生长吗？
